# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 23 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 35 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_023_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 23

**1** Jesus said: "I will choose you — one from a thousand and two from ten thousand — and they will stand as a single one."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "I will choose you" — the election is Jesus's initiative; the disciples are chosen, not self-selected
- The ratio: 1:1,000 and 2:10,000 — extreme selectivity; only the rarest few
- "Stand as a single one" — despite their plurality (one, two), the chosen become unified
- The saying defines the true disciple quantitatively (very rare) and qualitatively (unified/single)

---
